spec.txt#625: linkify-it ends a URL at the first unbalanced ')'; GFM only trims unbalanced trailing parens, so www.google.com/search?q=(business))+ok is cut after '(business)'.
spec.txt#626: GFM trims an entity-like suffix ('&hl;') from autolinks; linkify-it keeps '&hl' in the URL and only drops the ';'.
spec.txt#630: linkify-it accepts '+' in an email domain (hello@mail+xyz.example); GFM only allows it in the local part.
extensions.txt#17: markdown-it's strikethrough needs '~~'; github.com also accepts single '~text~'.
extensions.txt#18: Same single-tilde gap as extensions.txt#17, and markdown-it pairs runs of 3+ tildes into nested <del> where GFM leaves them literal.
extensions.txt#19: linkify-it diverges on several autolink edge cases in this one example: no xmpp: scheme, no email after '/' or after 'mmmmailto:'/'at:', different '_' host rules, a '.' kept before ')', and punycode instead of percent-encoded hrefs for non-ASCII hosts.
extensions.txt#26: markdown-it's inline linkify swallows the closing '~~' into a scheme URL (http://google.com~~), and a www link directly inside '~~' isn't linked.
